text:
Rhea: Quick check-in before tomorrow's newsletter launch. Need a send plan that avoids hitting ISP rate limits and keeps our engagement signal healthy. Outline in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample

Cass: Segments we agreed on: beta-invite (3.5k), engaged-trial (25k), newsletter-only (95k), churned-but-opened (6k). We're doing two subject variants for engaged, single for others.

Omar: Recommend swapping churned-but-opened into a re-engagement flow with a different CTA (short survey). Also suggest adding a seed VIP list (internal + 50 users) for final proof.

Diego: Deliverability constraints: our current warmup allows 12k/hour on the main provider. For the big cohort we should space to 8k/hr and use domain rotation for highest-volume bins. Also whitelist Google postmaster checks.

Ava: Copy notes: keep the headline technical but approachable. For beta-invite CTA use "Request early access"; for engaged-trial use "Deploy with Redwood today". Preheader draft: "Benchmarking inference latency and cost for real apps" (keep <100 chars).

Rhea: A/B test plan: engaged-trial gets subject A/B and CTA A/B. newsletter-only is pure deliverability baseline. churned group gets a 5-day re-engage drip if they click.

Cass: Timezones: map users to local send windows where possible (US 13:00-15:00 local, EMEA 10:00-12:00 local, APAC 11:00-14:00 local). For records with no TZ, fallback to inferred country field. I'll export a tz-mapped CSV in 20m.

Omar: Operational runbook: wave sizes and timing below. We'll monitor complainers and pause any IP with >0.03% complaint rate per hour. Also watch bounce spikes >1%.

Diego: Send commands (staged):
```
send-cli --env=prod --campaign=rdw_launch_march --wave=seed --limit=3600
send-cli --env=prod --campaign=rdw_launch_march --wave=engaged --limit=8000 --rotate-domain
send-cli --env=prod --campaign=rdw_launch_march --wave=newsletter_bin1 --limit=8000
```
I'll hand off to infra to start domain rotation tonight.

Ava: Accessibility: include alt text on images, provide plain-text version, and ensure contrast ratio passes AA. Also remove emoji in subject lines for engaged cohort.

Rhea: QA checklist: link tracking tested, unsub link present, suppression lists applied (global opt-outs, support tickets last 72h, hard bounce suppression), seed inbox checks across Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo.

send-batch-bot: Planned waves created:
- seed_wave ts=1788883000 recipients=3600 type=preview
- engaged_wave ts=1788887200 recipients=25000 variant=A/B ramp=10/30/60
- newsletter_wave_start ts=1788890800 recipients=95000 window=36h chunk=3
- churn_reengage_delay ts=1788960000 recipients=6000 drip=5d

Cass: Post-send metrics: I'll build a simple dashboard for opens, clicks, hard bounces, complaint rate, and CTA conversions by segment + region. Alert if CTR <1.2% for engaged after 24h or complaints >0.04%.

Omar: Notes for follow-up: capture UTM per-variant, log opens server-side for accurate metrics, and snapshot raw headers for any future deliverability review.

Diego: I'll coordinate with infra to throttle and flip domain rotation. If any provider asks to pause, we'll pause and move volume to secondary provider.

Rhea: Great. Action owners: Cass export tz mapping + dashboard, Ava finalize copy + plain-text by 5pm PT, Diego prepare domains/rotation + run warmup tonight, Omar set re-engagement drip logic. We'll reconvene in #marketing after the first wave to capture learnings. :rocket:
